description: Stations de chemin de fer existantes et/ou en projet de la région Île-de-France localisées sur la CDGT du Sdrif approuvé par décret le 27 décembre 2013 is a dataset listed in Plateforme open data de la Région Île-de-France, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by L'Institut Paris Region. [Situation 2013] Couche de points recensant l'ensemble des points d'arrêts existants et en projet, retenus pour le Sdrif 2013: gares ferrées, gares du Grand Paris, stations de métros hors Paris. Cette couche est à utiliser avec les couches de réseaux existants et en projets. Coverage: Île-de-France. The portal files it under Déplacements - transports, Aménagement du territoire. Its keywords are Planification, Gare, Transports en commun, SDRIF. The portal shows 547 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-02-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-iledefrance-fr-portal.
